name: correctness

findings.message: The `parallel.group.complete` event is emitted with `verdict=pass` when all map members have `outcome=fail` (no unfinished members), because the verdict expression checks only `_ZB_MAP_UNFINISHED` and not `ZBUILD_RUN_FLAGGED`; the new stop block then immediately fails the pipeline, so the emitted verdict contradicts the actual group outcome — this inconsistency is introduced by this change for the `on_member_error=continue` scenario (e.g. the review-lenses group), whereas for `on_member_error=collect` the same event/outcome mismatch pre-existed via the `_rc -ne 0` path.

reason: the correctness lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
